package.name: aav_kinematic_icp
package.description: Lidar odometry that knows it is on a car (Kinematic-ICP's idea, in Rust; TODO 216): each step one arc, the wheels a prior. A drop-in for aav_kiss_icp: /sensors/lidar/points and /vehicle/odom in; /localization/kiss_icp/odom and status out. A challenger (sim.launch.py odom_lidar:=kinematic_icp). The maths is the kinematic-icp crate, with no ROS.
